title: Algorithms for the Maximum Edge Open Packing Problem
summary: Packing problems form a central theme in graph theory, owing to their relevance in modeling conflict-free resource allocation, network design, and communication constraints. Motivated by applications in wireless networks where each device can participate in at most one communication at a time and simultaneous links must avoid interference we consider a generalization of induced matching known as \emph{edge open packing}.
